narrator.instruct: Excited, wildly expressive comedy narrator. Big reactions, slightly sarcastic, never calm.

emma.instruct: Bright, cheerful, warm, calling out to a pet far away.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You wake up with an eagle's vision.

voice.instruct: Punchy, amazed opening hook, like announcing a superpower.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And HOLY COW!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You can see EVERYTHING!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A tiny bird flying way up in the sky?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: NO PROBLEM!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then you look across the street.

voice.instruct: Casual, nosy, setting up a secret.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your neighbor is picking his nose.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Wait. DID HE JUST EAT THAT?!

voice.instruct: Mock horror, rising to a scream.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: EWW! WHY CAN I SEE THIS?!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You quickly look away.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: OH! Your crush is waving at you!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You wave back!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hey, Buddy!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Wait a second. She's waving at the DOG behind you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: AWESOME. JUST AWESOME.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But hey! At least you've got super eyes!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You spot another bird high in the sky.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: WOW! LOOK AT THAT THING!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You keep staring up. And then.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: BONK!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You walk straight into a glass door!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Congratulations!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You've got eagle eyes. AND A PIGEON BRAIN!

voice.instruct: Deadpan, then a punchy final line.
